meta.label: Tourist accommodation bed capacity (2024)
meta.methodNote: Total registered tourist-accommodation bed capacity (hotels and similar establishments plus campsites, holiday rentals, agritourism, hostels, B&Bs and other collective accommodation), ISTAT's comune-level capacity survey, 2024. This is installed capacity (how many beds exist), not realized occupancy (see the seasonality-index and peak-visitor-multiplier layers for how full those beds actually get across the year) — a comune can have a large bed capacity that sits mostly empty, or a small one that's booked solid.
meta.coverageNote: Covers 7899 of Italy's ~7,900 comuni — unlike the seasonality-index/peak-visitor-multiplier layers from the same broader source, this capacity dataset carries no disclosure-confidentiality suppression at all: a comune with zero registered tourist accommodation gets a real row of zeros, not an absent one. A further 386 comuni are excluded because their ISTAT code in this source doesn't match a current comuni.json id — the same old-province-scheme Sardinia towns and pre-merger codes documented on the seasonality layers, plus several more (this file's coverage goes back to 2002, so it carries more stale codes) — excluded rather than guessed at.
